title: Docker Fundamentals
description: Learn what containers are, how Docker works, and the basics of images, containers, and Dockerfiles.
longDescription: This module introduces containerization with Docker. You'll learn the difference between VMs and containers, how the Docker Engine works, how to build and run images, and how to write your first Dockerfile. By the end, you'll be comfortable running containers and building lightweight images.
whatYouLearn: Understand containers and the Docker architecture
Run and manage containers with docker run
